title: Notification No. A.1324/1994 dated 10/08/2026, regarding appointment to the post of Assistant Director, Gujarat State Judicial Academy, Ahmedabad.

No. A.1324/1994
NOTIFICATION
The Honourable Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabadhas been
pleased to appoint Dr. Purvi Kaushikbhai Pandya, 11thAdditional Senior Civil Judge
and Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Civil Court Ahmedabad(Rural),
Ahmedabad as Assistant Director, Gujarat State Judicial Academy, Ahmedabad, on
deputationbasis.
Further, Honourable the Chief Justice has been pleased to direct Dr. Purvi
Kaushikbhai Pandyato report for taking chargeof the post on 17/08/2026.
By order of the Honourable Chief
Justice of the High Court of Gujarat.
High Court of Gujarat at Sola,
Ahmedabad- 380060. W'\- :'~(SanjB D. Suthar)th
